# Provisional `eqoa/1` names

<!-- Generated by tools/api_tiers.py from docs/modding/eqoa-1-tiers.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

1359 of the 2237 `eqoa/1` names are provisional; 878 are proven. (The FrontiersForge layer, 367 names, is neither: see [VERSIONING.md](VERSIONING.md).)

A provisional name works and is covered by the client's automated tests, but no mod shipped with the client uses it yet, so it has not been exercised in real play. After the final freeze a provisional name may still be corrected, and every correction is listed in the release notes. When a mod uses a provisional name in real play it becomes proven and gets the full promise of [VERSIONING.md](VERSIONING.md); a name never goes back from proven to provisional.
